core_problem_solved: To provide an open-source Java library for creating and manipulating PDF documents under a permissive license.
key_features: Support for adding text, images, and tables to documents
era_and_niche: A highly popular and foundational PDF library for Java in the 2000s, known for its powerful feature set and permissive (MPL/LGPL) open-source license.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete**. The project continued under a new coordinate, **`com.itextpdf:itextpdf`**, with a more restrictive AGPL license starting with version 5. Due to this license change, a popular community fork of this older, permissively licensed version (2.x) was created, called **OpenPDF (`com.github.librepdf:openpdf`)**.
